name: swiss-passport-zh
description: Learn for the naturalisation knowledge test (Grundkenntnistest) of the Canton of Zurich, in 6 languages.
long_description: Short lessons, spaced reviews and 50-question mock exams based on the 350 official questions of the Canton of Zurich. Explanations are checked against official sources. Languages: German, English, French, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian. Progress is saved only on your computer.

tools.name: get_progress
tools.description: Lessons done, reviews due, readiness per topic.

tools.name: start_lesson
tools.description: Starts the next lesson, one question at a time.

tools.name: start_reviews
tools.description: Starts a round of due spaced reviews.

tools.name: start_mock_exam
tools.description: Starts a 50-question mock exam like the official practice test.

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Answers the current question and returns the next step.
